id: title:DanielVisca:fail open on infra errors and harden transformation globals

observations.behavior: Adds tests checking that trace/span IDs are decoded from base64 to hex and zeroed/unparseable buffers become null.
observations.posthog_connection: These checks ensure the hog-log-exec module produces consistent record fields regardless of input encoding or garbage values.

observations.behavior: Replaces inline hex conversion with an exported helper; P1.F2 also exports this helper.
observations.posthog_connection: This unifies how log records expose their identity fields downstream, supporting warehouse ingestion and metric rules.

observations.behavior: Wraps function fetch in a try-catch and returns early without dropping records on failure.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides fail-open behavior so transient infrastructure errors do not cause message loss or DLQs.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks were examined. No score is assigned because tier assignment requires broader assessment of systemic benefit and complete implementation coverage.

review.limitations: Only three hunks were examined. No score is assigned because tier assignment requires broader assessment of systemic benefit and complete implementation coverage.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates bounded correctness improvements: shared utility export, explicit decoding behavior, and documented fail-open handling. These could support reliability but lack evidence of broader systemic change across components.
review.posthog_relevance: Changes affect logs transformation execution and compatibility between capture-logs and other products that consume these identities.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies only on selected hunks; full review would clarify whether the changes are isolated or part of larger architectural shifts.
